headword: {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}
gloss: lesson plan; teaching plan; course plan

definitions.gloss: lesson plan; teaching plan; course plan
definitions.explanation: A written plan outlining what will be taught in a class or course — the sequence of topics, teaching methods, learning objectives, and materials to be used. Prepared by teachers for a single lesson, a unit, or a whole semester, and often submitted to supervisors or shared with students.

examples.japanese: {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: To draw up a lesson plan.

examples.english: The teacher submits a lesson plan every week.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ ('class; lesson') and ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ ('plan'). A practical, everyday word used in primary, secondary, and higher education to refer to the teacher's written plan for what to cover in class. Can refer to a single lesson's plan or to a broader course-level plan.

USAGE:
- Used throughout education — from elementary-school teacher training to university pedagogy courses.
- At universities, overlaps heavily with シラバス ('syllabus'), though {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく} is the native-Japanese equivalent that appears on official forms.
- Typical verbs: ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ ('to draw up'), ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ ('to make'), ⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ ('to submit'), ⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ ('to change'), ⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ ('to review').
- Often discussed together with ⟦{学習指導要領|がくしゅうしどうようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧ ('national curriculum guidelines') as the macro framework that lesson plans align with.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to draw up a lesson plan
- {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to create a lesson plan
- {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a lesson plan
- {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: in line with the lesson plan
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}: annual lesson plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導案|しどうあん}→指導案：16670_shidouan⟧: teaching plan — more specific term for a detailed, single-lesson plan used in teacher training and school inspections; includes minute-by-minute steps.
- シラバス: syllabus — standard at universities; covers course-level goals, evaluation, and weekly topics.
- ⟦{学習指導要領|がくしゅうしどうようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧: national curriculum guidelines — the government-issued framework all school lesson plans must follow.
- ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧: curriculum — the overall program of study across multiple courses, broader than a single {授業計画|じゅぎょうけいかく}.
- ⟦{教案|きょうあん}→教案：26171_kyouan⟧: lesson plan — older / more traditional term, largely synonymous with ⟦{指導案|しどうあん}→指導案：16670_shidouan⟧ but less common in modern use.
